title: Retain and review run output
description: On an isolated gateway, seed a finished artifact-only run with a real worker task directory and report. Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY, FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_RUN_ID and FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_REPORT_SHA256 from the original report bytes. Run before and after acknowledging through Command Center. No project or QA profile is assumed. Negative control: use a different expected hash and confirm the report assertion fails. For the browser node, set FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT and FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_ROUTE to the isolated run route including its unique query. Reload that page before running; after acknowledgement it must retain files without a resource-transition wait. Set FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_FAMILY_ROUTE to the family route with the selected run. Set FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_REPORT_TEXT to expected report text and FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_LINKED_PATH to an artifact linked from the report; start with the lightbox closed.

refresh-output.intent: Prove run.refreshMirror retains indexed output and a review decision while run status, verdict, execution steps and acknowledgement remain unchanged. Open the report in Command Center and follow a nested artifact link; acknowledge only on the isolated copy. Re-run to verify the acknowledgement survives refresh.

browser-output.cmd: node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs eval "$FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_ROUTE" 'const root = document.querySelector("run-detail")?.shadowRoot; const files = root?.querySelector("[data-testid=run-output-files] summary")?.textContent; if (!files || !/Browse files \([1-9][0-9]*\)/.test(files)) throw new Error("Retained files missing after navigation"); if (root.textContent.includes("not finished reconciling your last resolution")) throw new Error("Output review incorrectly waits for a resource transition"); return { files, resourceWait: false };'
browser-output.intent: Verify the normal detail page hydrates its omitted file manifest after reload, and output acknowledgement does not trigger a resource transition. This reads the real DOM without injecting state.

family-files.cmd: node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs eval "$FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_FAMILY_ROUTE" 'const root = document.querySelector("family-observability")?.shadowRoot; const files = root?.querySelector("[data-testid=family-browse-files] summary")?.textContent; if (!files || !/Browse files \([1-9][0-9]*\)/.test(files)) throw new Error("Family files missing"); if (!root.querySelector("[data-testid=family-read-report]")) throw new Error("Family report link missing"); return { files, reportAvailable: true };'
family-files.intent: Prove the family page exposes the selected run files returned by family.observability.get. Click Read report and a nested evidence link in the real browser to verify file content renders.

family-report-links.intent: Use real CDP clicks to open the family report, assert its expected content, follow a nested artifact link and assert the selected file. Negative control: supply incorrect expected report text and confirm the assertion fails.
